instructions: Use comparable factors for both destinations.

criteria.description: The answer should discuss strengths and limitations of both destinations.
criteria.title: Compares both destinations using relevant factors

criteria.description: The selected destination should follow from the traveller profile, interest, and constraint.
criteria.title: Makes and justifies a clear recommendation

criteria.description: Material factual claims about each destination should have suitable supporting sources.
criteria.title: Evidence is provided for both destinations

criteria.description: The comparison and recommendation should explicitly account for the stated requirement.
criteria.title: Applies the additional requirement

constraint.description: avoid activities requiring more than 2 kilometres of walking

traveller.description: a solo traveller without access to a private car

prompt:
Compare Strahan, TAS, and
Longreach, QLD, for
a solo traveller without access to a private car whose main interest is local food and wine.

Recommend one destination and explain the trade-offs. Apply this additional
requirement: avoid activities requiring more than 2 kilometres of walking. Support material factual claims with
current citations, especially claims about access, transport, operating conditions,
and suitability. State uncertainty where the evidence is incomplete.
